terra.problem: The psalm doesn't say the psalmist avoids giving thanks in private, and it doesn't identify the speaker as a man.
The psalm mentions the council and assembly, but it doesn't say they are in a room.
The verse says people delight in and ponder the works; it doesn't say whether they protect them.
The verse says God sent redemption, but it doesn't say His people didn't have to go fetch it.
